title: Bump test 0-forms with prescribed value at the centre
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, z ∈ ℝ^P and a, c ∈ ℝ with a > 0 and closedBall(z, a) ⊆ U. Then there is ω ∈ 𝒟^0(U) (TestFormOn U 0: a C^∞ 0-form on ℝ^P with compact support and tsupport ω ⊆ U) such that (i) tsupport ω ⊆ closedBall(z, a); (ii) ω(z)(()) = c, where () = (fun i => i.elim0) is the empty family Fin 0 → ℝ^P; (iii) ω(x) = 0 for every x ∉ ball(z, a); and (iv) covectorEuclideanNorm(ω(x)) ≤ |c| for every x ∈ ℝ^P, where covectorEuclideanNorm is the Euclidean coefficient norm of SimonGMT (Chapter06/Mass.lean) used in the definition of M_W.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (z : Euclid P) (a c : ℝ), 0 < a → closedBall z a ⊆ U → ∃ ω : TestFormOn U 0, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 0) ⊆ closedBall z a ∧ (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 0) z (fun i => i.elim0) = c ∧ (∀ x, x ∉ ball z a → (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 0) x = 0) ∧ ∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 0) x) ≤ |c|
